summary.name: Sigil
summary.one_liner: Sigil is a multi-platform editor for creating EPUB ebooks, published by the Sigil-Ebook GitHub organization.
use_cases: Visual editing of ebook pages with PageEdit
summary.what_it_does: ["Sigil is an editor designed to make it easy to create ebooks in the EPUB format. The page describes it as an EPUB editor. PageEdit is a separate WYSIWYG XHTML editor described as a companion app for Sigil. The page links to the project's GitHub repository and a feed. The page itself gives few technical details beyond these descriptions."]
notable: Listed as open-source freeware on awesome-mac
caveats: The page does not name supported platforms; the awesome-mac listing describes it as multi-platform
